findings.statement: Entity type is Individual in California, where sole proprietors are not registered with the Secretary of State, so no entity filing is expected. A cosmetology/barbering licence would normally be required for the declared trade (hair, nails, make-up), but the California DCA licence lookup is a JavaScript form that cannot be queried by automation, so no licence record could be checked. This remains an open manual check rather than a negative finding.
findings.establishes: No registration is expected for a CA sole proprietor; the required cosmetology licence could not be checked because the state licence registry blocks automated querying.

findings.statement: No independent listing (Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram, Nextdoor, BBB, Thumbtack, Fresha, Booksy) was found for "Mr fixxee upper" or any "Fixxee" variant in Sacramento, CA. The declared activity is a personal hair/nails/make-up service, which does not necessarily require licensed physical premises, so the absence of a footprint is treated as no evidence rather than a contradiction.
findings.establishes: The business has no discoverable public operating footprint in the stated city, but its service type does not require one, so no risk points are assigned.

findings.statement: The statement descriptor matches the representative recorded on the Stripe account, so there is no descriptor/representative mismatch. Searches of web, social, review and directory sources returned no occurrence of that name in connection with this business, with Sacramento, or with any hair/nails/make-up trade, and nothing public contradicts the representative either. Identity documents and bank ownership are verified only by Stripe (status: verified).
findings.establishes: The representative is consistent with the statement descriptor but is neither corroborated nor contradicted by any public source.

findings.statement: No website is declared and none could be found. The email handle "paymee95815v@gmail.com" reads as payment-collection language ("pay me") combined with the merchant’s own Sacramento ZIP code rather than describing a trade, and no trade-describing public footprint exists to offset it: the Sacramento beauty-provider directory loaded for this check contains no entry matching this business or descriptor name. The business name also does not cohere with the declared trade.
findings.establishes: The merchant has no verifiable web presence and its only contact identifier describes collecting payment rather than a trade.

findings.statement: MCC 7230 (beauty/barber shops) and the product description "I do hair, nails and make up" do not cohere with the business name "Mr fixxee upper", which is home-repair/handyman language; the only similarly named Sacramento businesses found are handyman and renovation firms. Nothing observable confirms that this merchant sells beauty services: the Sacramento beauty-provider directory loaded for this check contains no matching provider.
findings.establishes: The declared MCC and trade are inconsistent with the business name and unsupported by any observable service offering.

findings.statement: No dated reviews, listings, filings, news items, complaints or scam/fraud reports were found for this business or the descriptor name, so no trading history of any length could be established, and equally no negative history exists in public sources.
findings.establishes: There is no evidence of independent presence over time, and no adverse history either.

evidenceNeeded: California DCA / Board of Barbering and Cosmetology licence lookup (search.dca.ca.gov) for the representative and for any establishment licence at the Sacramento address - the registry could not be queried by automation.
Sacramento County fictitious business name (DBA) index check for "Mr fixxee upper".
Merchant explanation for the mismatch between a handyman-sounding business name and the declared MCC 7230 beauty trade, plus a booking page or social handle.
Evidence of the trade: price list, portfolio, appointment system, or service area.
summary: Five-day-old Individual account in Sacramento, CA with no declared website and no discoverable public footprint of any kind. Two material inconsistencies stand out: the business name is handyman/home-repair language while the MCC and product description describe hair, nails and make-up, and the only contact identifier is a Gmail handle reading as payment-collection language plus the merchant’s own ZIP. The statement descriptor does match the Stripe representative and nothing adverse was found, so this is unsubstantiated-business risk rather than confirmed misuse. Recommend holding payouts pending a cosmetology licence check, a county DBA check and merchant-supplied proof of the beauty trade.
